## Cost of ideal simulation (random circuit of 50 gates)

| Qubits | Seconds | State size (MB) |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 2 | 0.0017 | 0.0 |
| 4 | 0.0017 | 0.0 |
| 6 | 0.0014 | 0.001 |
| 8 | 0.0016 | 0.004 |
| 10 | 0.0024 | 0.016 |
| 12 | 0.004 | 0.062 |
| 14 | 0.0108 | 0.25 |
| 16 | 0.0357 | 1.0 |

Memory and time double with every added qubit; the app caps circuits at 6 qubits. These checks show the simulator is numerically correct for ideal gates, not that it models real hardware noise.
